== Summary ==
Joe Alread of Normal, IL shows no fear in the Star Wars CCG Iron Man event. As cards are lost, they're shredded or torn. Photo: Decipher. See [[DecipherCon 1999]], [[1999 Decipher World Championship]], [[DecipherCon 1999 photographs]], [[Joe Alread]].
